The present First Appeal is filed under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (hereinafter referred to as 'the Act') challenging the impugned judgment and order dated 05.10.2018 passed in Land Acquisition Reference (LAR) Case No.270 of 2008 in group LAR Case No.265 to 279 of 2008 by learned Principal Senior Civil Judge, Lalpur.
opennyai_summary.final__ANALYSIS:
Notification under Section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act was published on 03.07.2006 and Notification under Section 6 of the Act was published on 01.09.2007.
6. Considering the aforesaid factual aspect, a chance is given to appellant to substantiate his claim of more compensation in the reference proceedings.
opennyai_summary.final__facts:
Land Acquisition Officer passed award under Section 11 on 27.05.2008 and awarded compensation at Rs.6.40/- per square meter for irrigated land and Rs.5.89 per square meter for non- irrigated land.
Since the award was on meager side, appellant - land loosers filed reference under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act for enhancement of compensation.
The learned Reference Court dismissed the reference for default.
The purpose of the Land Acquisition Act is a benevolent legislation.
Land loosers who have lost their lands and livelihood in the process of acquisition, are required to be compensated by adequate compensation.
The appellant/s who claimed to be aggrieved by the award of the compensation awarded by Land Acquisition Officer is required to be given a chance to prove his case.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
However, to meet the equity, appellant shall not be entitled to interest on any enhanced compensation, if awarded, in favour of the appellant from the date of framing of issues till 16.10.2021, the day on which, the First Appeal was filed with an application for condonation of delay.
Under these circumstances, this is a fit case to remand back the matter.
Accordingly, the impugned judgment and decree dated 05.10.2018 passed in Land Acquisition Reference (LAR) Case No.270 of 2008 in group LAR Case No.265 to 279 of 2008 by learned Principal Senior Civil Judge,
Lalpur, is hereby quashed and set aside.
The learned Reference Court is directed to hear and decide the reference/s afresh after considering the above list of documents and after giving opportunity of hearing to both the sides to lead the evidence.
It is expected that the learned Reference Court shall decide the matter afresh without being influenced by its earlier order and shall decide the NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/4388/2023 ORDER DATED: 08/09/2025 undefined matter upon evidence placed before it preferably within a period of one year from the date of the receipt of the writ of this order.
The parties are directed to cooperate with the reference Court for early disposal of the reference case.
9. With the aforesaid observations and directions, present appeal stands disposed of.

The learned Reference Court is directed to hear and decide the reference/s afresh after considering the above list of documents and after giving opportunity of hearing to both the sides to lead the evidence.

It is expected that the learned Reference Court shall decide the matter afresh without being influenced by its earlier order and shall decide the NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/4388/2023 ORDER DATED: 08/09/2025 undefined matter upon evidence placed before it preferably within a period of one year from the date of the receipt of the writ of this order.
The parties are directed to cooperate with the reference Court for early disposal of the reference case.
9. With the aforesaid observations and directions, present appeal stands disposed of.
